flashbackexportextras.stereo_audio_toolt:
Records export audio in stereo.
Mono collapses all positional/3D audio directionality at capture time.
Only applies when Record audio is enabled; overrides the stereo audio option below.
flashbackexportextras.export_camera_path:
Export camera animation alongside the render.
Includes position, rotation, and FOV keyframes.
flashbackexportextras.relative_camera_pa:
Shift the camera path so the first frame is at (0,0,0).
Easier to position assets in Blender.
flashbackexportextras.exr_info:
Exports multilayer OpenEXR frames with color and depth.
Anti-aliasing is disabled for depth accuracy.
flashbackexportextras.exr_output_name_to: Frames are written to a single-level subfolder with this name. Leave blank to generate a timestamped name automatically.
flashbackexportextras.linearize_depth_to:
Convert NDC depth [0,1] to world-space distance.
Recommended for Blender compositing — depth values become actual block distances.
flashbackexportextras.exr_compression_to: Choose the trade-off between EXR file size and export speed. All modes are lossless.
flashbackexportextras.exr_compression_zi: Smallest files, but slower export. Lossless.
Balanced file size and export speed. Lossless.
flashbackexportextras.exr_compression_no: Fastest export, but substantially larger files. Lossless.
flashbackexportextras.exr_scene_linear_h: HDR color is unavailable in this version or HDR Mod is not enabled. Standard SDR color will be exported.
flashbackexportextras.exr_color_tooltip:
Color encoding of the OpenEXR Combined layer.
Scene-linear keeps values above 1.0 for compositing.
S-Log3 matches the S-Log3 video export (BT.2020 primaries, S-Log3 transfer).
ACEScct is the ACES log grading encoding (AP1 primaries, AMPAS S-2016-001).
Scene-linear and ACEScct keep the full unclamped scene range; S-Log3 matches the video deliverable (curve-capped at ~16x scene linear).
flashbackexportextras.hdr_export_tooltip:
Export HDR10 video with BT.2020 primaries and ST.2084 PQ transfer function.
Requires HDR Mod and an HDR-compatible Iris shaderpack.
flashbackexportextras.hdr_peak_brightnes:
Maximum display luminance for PQ (HDR10) encoding.
Default: 1000 nits (HDR10 standard). Increase for brighter HDR screens.
Not used by S-Log3, which is scene-referred.
flashbackexportextras.hdr_quality_preset: Encoder speed/quality trade-off (x264/x265-style names; mapped to the closest equivalent for other encoders).
flashbackexportextras.hdr_crf_tooltip:
Constant-quality rate control for encoders that support CRF/CQ.
Lower = better quality and larger files (typical: 16-22).
flashbackexportextras.hdr_bitrate_hint:
Encoders without CRF support (ProRes, AMF, VideoToolbox) use the video bitrate setting below.
With "use maximum bitrate" enabled, a suitable bitrate is chosen automatically.
flashbackexportextras.hdr_codec_note:
10-bit encoder notes: H.264 software (libx264) requires an FFmpeg build with 10-bit x264 support.
H.264 hardware encoders cannot carry 10-bit HDR.
flashbackexportextras.hdr_h264_hw_note:
HDR export is disabled: the selected H.264 hardware encoder (NVENC/AMF/VideoToolbox) is 8-bit only and cannot carry 10-bit HDR.
Switch to H.265 / AV1 / ProRes, or the software H.264 (libx264) encoder.
flashbackexportextras.slog3_export_toolt:
Export 10-bit S-Log3 video with BT.2020 primaries and Sony S-Log3 transfer.
SDR white maps to 90% scene white; decode with an S-Log3 -> Rec.709 color space transform in your NLE (no exposure change needed).
Video containers have no S-Log3 code point, so the transfer characteristic is left unspecified — select S-Log3 in your NLE.
Requires HDR Mod and an HDR-compatible Iris shaderpack.
